headline: I'm Cami Paganelli. I help organizations understand their reality and make better decisions.

blocks.title: Who I am.
paragraphs: I work across finance, data and processes. Before proposing a solution, I make sure I understand how the business works and which information really matters. Then I organize it, translate it and turn it into decisions.

I worked on retail credit products at BBVA Argentina as Design Lead and senior analyst, and held product roles at Leafnoise. {{pending:years of experience.}} I now work independently with companies and with small businesses and startups in my community.

blocks.title: Why Bariloche.
paragraphs: I live in Bariloche by choice. I work with clients here and elsewhere, and I like that businesses in my city can have the same level of analysis as a large company.

blocks.title: How I think.
paragraphs: I'm interested in what sits between teams, numbers and people. Sustainable change needs all three.

blocks.title: Tools.
paragraphs: SQL, Excel, Looker Studio, SAP, Salesforce, MicroStrategy, Teradata, Zapier, Make, N8N, Botmaker.
